# Directorate of Open and Distance Learning (DODL) - University of Kalyani

> UGC-recognized distance education directorate offering postgraduate programs through open and distance learning modalities with learner support centers across West Bengal.

DODL is the dedicated directorate of University of Kalyani providing self-paced, flexible postgraduate education programs compliant with UGC-DEB regulations. The directorate serves students across West Bengal through multiple study centers and maintains institutional quality assurance through CIQAC oversight.
